why: 9 of the 315 reference tests read real documents that live OUTSIDE the reference's tests/ directory, so the reference suite is not hermetic. They are the document-cut tests -- the exact logic AC#17(a) covers -- so leaving them dead would leave V1's truncation fix unverified in this repo. Owner ruling 2026-09-28: vendor both, recorded, used only by tests.
resolved_as: The vendored tests address these by the reference's repo-relative paths, so tests/conftest.py symlinks them into place at session start rather than editing any vendored test. The import-rename-only property is therefore preserved on all 7 files.
